items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context; the mention of Blanche Tukat is made solely by the interviewer.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm . I think I've heard that myself, but I don't know if it was Ori or what. Blanche Tukat is one Ori sings. Yeah, Blanche Tukat, yeah. It was another one, wasn't it? Yeah, he had one called, the play sings, A La Pa, and one called Creole Boba, which is the same tune as Twinkle Twinkle Little Star. Remember that bit? Oh yeah. Do you know Twinkle Twinkle Little Star? The song in English is Twinkle Twinkle? No. Can you whistle that for our knowledge? Yeah. With the hat? Yeah. Yeah.
That's it, eh? Yeah. Up above the moon so high, up above the world so high. The world so high. Like a diamond in the sky.
